description:
Correct the building orientation and optimize ground-floor cooling supply air temperatures in the 4StoreyBuilding model. 

1. Locate the building-level parameters and change the Azimuth from 0 to 90 degrees.
2. For ALL five Ground Floor packaged single-zone systems (names starting with 'G.'), increase the Zone Cooling Supply Temperature (COOL-SET-T) from 55°F to 58°F.
3. Run the annual simulation and save the project.

No step-by-step UI instructions provided. You must navigate the eQUEST interface independently.
